availability.note: Mazda AU Build & Price (https://www.mazda.com.au/build/cx-80/) and the CX-80 model page render no grade or price data to automated fetches; the model page names Pure, Touring, GT, Azami and Azami with SP Pack and the 241kW PHEV. CarExpert's July 2026 table lists four P50e lines (Touring, GT, Azami, Azami SP); EV Central (23 Jul 2026) and CarsGuide's 2027 CX-80 price page list the same four P50e grades at the same prices, so the line-up carried into MY27 unchanged. Pure is petrol/diesel only. No 'Vision' rename on the CX-80. P50e Touring orderable.

listPrice.note: CarExpert 22 Jul 2026 price table headed 'Price before on-road costs': P50e Touring $68,100. EV Central 23 Jul 2026 gives the same figure 'before on-road costs' (https://evcentral.com.au/mazda-takes-the-axe-to-phev-pricing-cx-60-and-cx-80-plug-ins-now-up-to-8119-cheaper/). No Mazda AU MLP release for the July 2026 repricing was found (mazda-news listing shows no CX-80 pricing item; 2024 launch release has no prices), so the manufacturer's own figure could not be read. Unchanged since the held 2026-07-28 data; CarsGuide's 2027 page (MSRP, excludes on-roads) also shows $68,100 but is not relied on because it lists the Azami SP as 7 seats. Current Mazda offers (Nov 2026: G40e Pure drive-away, $2,000 cashback) are campaigns, not list changes.

batteryKwh.note: Usable capacity is unpublished. 17.8 kWh is gross (ADAC 'Batteriekapazitaet (Brutto) 17,8 kWh'; Mazda AU 2024 launch release '17.8 kWh Lithium ion battery'). Same pack as mazda-cx-60-phev, which judges 14.0 kWh usable (heise: engine refires near 19-26% SoC). Cross-check: CarExpert's Touring week measured 26.3 kWh/100km grid energy; WLTP 60 km x 23.3 kWh/100km = 14.0 kWh. Aligned to the sibling.

rangeKm.note: European WLTP electric range for the current (ab 11/25) CX-80 PHEV on 235/50R20, 60 km (same on Takumi, https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/mazda/cx-80/kl/346718/); the 10/24-11/25 car was 61 km (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/mazda/cx-80/kl/334509/). Current certification used, matching mazda-cx-60-phev. Australian 65 km (Mazda AU page 'up to 65km'; CarExpert labels it NEDC) is higher than WLTP and rejected by the direction test. EU lists only 20-inch PHEVs; CarExpert reports the AU Touring on 18-inch wheels, so the Touring's real WLTP could be a km or two higher.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 14.0 / 60 x 100. ADAC's 14.6 kWh/100km and Mazda AU's label are utility-weighted, not used. Consistent with CarExpert's measured 26.3 kWh/100km at the plug less charging loss.

combinedRangeKm.note: WLTP electric 60 km + 70 L tank / 8.0 L/100km x 100 (875 km) = 935 km. Tank 70 L from ADAC and CarExpert Touring review.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: European WLTP 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer)' 8.0 L/100km (ab 11/25; 8.1 for 10/24-11/25). Same basis as kia-sorento-phev and mazda-cx-60-phev (ADAC battery-empty). Australian real-world: GoAuto Azami SP week 7.8 L/100km; Driving Enthusiast 7.0-7.2. Held 7.0 was the real-world figure.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Mazda AU CX-80 page: 2.7L/100km (ADR 81/02 combined) for the PHEV, below 3.5.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green car = combined tailpipe CO2 120 g/km or less; CX-80 P50e label is 64 g/km (CarExpert launch price-and-specs, https://carexpert.com.au/car-news/2025-mazda-cx-80-price-and-specs-seven-seat-suv-undercuts-cx-60).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 258 L with all three rows up (CarExpert 2026 Touring review; CarExpert launch article says measured to seatback height); ADAC 'Kofferraumvolumen normal' 258 L for the PHEV. Battery under floor, same as petrol/diesel. Matches sibling 7-seaters' all-rows-up basis (kia-sorento-phev).

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: 1,971 L with second and third rows folded, to the roof (CarExpert; ADAC 'dachhoch' 1971 L). To-the-roof, matching the folded basis on kia-sorento-phev (1988 L roof) refreshed today; ADAC's window-height folded figure is 1,221 L, which the cargo-cover convention would strictly prefer.

towKg.note: CarExpert Touring review braked 2,500 kg; ADAC 2,500 kg; EV Central tow list 2,500 kg.

insuranceAnnual.note: Held judgement kept (list unchanged at $68,100). Anchors: kia-sorento-phev S $71,175 -> $1,800, Sport+ $78,755 -> $1,950, GT-Line $86,115 -> $2,100; mitsubishi-outlander-phev Exceed Tourer $74,490 -> $1,850; mazda-cx-60-phev GT $70,640 -> $1,900.
